scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:node && pnpm run typecheck:web
scripts.dist: pnpm run prebuild:notes && pnpm run build:pi && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac -c.mac.identity=null -c.mac.notarize=false
scripts.dist:dir: pnpm run build:pi && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac --dir --publish never -c.mac.identity=null -c.mac.notarize=false
scripts.dist:zip: pnpm run prebuild:notes && pnpm run build:pi && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac zip --publish never -c.mac.identity=null -c.mac.notarize=false
scripts.dist:dmg: pnpm run prebuild:notes && pnpm run build:pi && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac dmg --publish never -c.mac.identity=null -c.mac.notarize=false
scripts.prepackage:mac: pnpm run prebuild:notes && pnpm run build:pi && pnpm run build:whisper && electron-vite build
scripts.prepackage:mac-x64: pnpm run prebuild:notes && node scripts/build-pi-binary.mjs --platform darwin --arch x64 && electron-vite build
scripts.prepackage:win: pnpm run prebuild:notes && node scripts/build-pi-binary.mjs --platform win32 --arch x64 && electron-vite build
